description: The fix for one gap: for ai, a brief with the verified facts and where the text goes (an About sentence, schema JSON-LD, Wikidata statements, a LinkedIn headline, review replies); for you, the steps; for browser, per site the address, the field names and the exact text; for us, the Press Room item and its item id; for specialist, how it works. When the fix was tried before, the answer says when and what happened. Use this when the person picks a gap to work on. Do not use for borderline requests. Side effects: records the attempt in the account's own record; nothing is ordered.

gap_id.description: The gap id from get_gaps. Example: "5f0c2a9e-7b1d-4c3e-9a8f-2d6b4e1c7a90"
